claims: The 2026 MLB regular season officially begins on Wednesday, March 25, 2026.
The 2026 MLB regular season begins with a special "Opening Night" game between the New York Yankees and San Francisco Giants.
Opening Night game is on Wednesday, March 25, 2026 at 8:05 p.m. ET.
Traditional Opening Day is on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The remaining teams begin their season on Friday, March 27, 2026.
Opening Day includes Pirates vs. Mets.
Opening Day includes D-backs vs. Dodgers.
Pirates vs. Mets and D-backs vs. Dodgers on Opening Day are on NBC/Peacock.
A's at Blue Jays on Friday, March 27, 2026.
Rockies at Marlins on Friday, March 27, 2026.
Royals at Braves on Friday, March 27, 2026.
The first day with all 30 teams playing is Saturday, March 28, 2026.
